message.reasoning:
We need to process orders and payments.

First, deduplicate e2e_id: all are unique.

Link payments to orders by txid when present. All payments have txid matching order ids.

No refunds present.

Now compute status per order.

We need to consider amount received (gross) per order = sum of distinct transfers linked.

All orders have one payment each, amount matches order amount exactly.

Now need to compare time of latest transfer (only one) with expires_at.

Times are given with same offset -03:00 as orders. Need to compare instants.

Order PED-57450: expires_at 2026-09-24T11:49:00-03:00. Payment time 2026-09-24T11:38:00-03:00, which is before expires, so on time. Status would be "paid". But rule order: unpaid, refunded, underpaid, overpaid, late_paid, paid. Since not any earlier, then paid.

PED-93231: expires_at 2026-09-24T18:13:00-03:00. Payment time 18:08:00-03:00, before expires, so paid.

PED-90992: expires_at 2026-09-24T12:15:00-03:00. Payment time 11:59, before, so paid.

PED-63343: expires_at 2026-09-24T11:38:00-03:00. Payment time 11:29:00-03:00, before, so paid.

PED-11234: expires_at 2026-09-24T18:01:00-03:00. Payment time 17:37, before, so paid.

Thus all orders are paid.

Payments list should include distinct e2e_id, sorted. Sorting lexicographically? Not specified, but "sorted". We'll sort ascending.

List per order:

PED-57450: ["E1189589760001"]
PED-93231: ["E2617132940002"]
PED-90992: ["E6964383050003"]
PED-63343: ["E6547529400004"]
PED-11234: ["E4467297980005"]

Now orphans: distinct e2e_ids of payment lines not linked to any order. All payments linked, so empty list [].

Now produce JSON.

Check schema: {"orders": {"<order_id>": {"status": "...", "payments": ["..."]}}, "orphans": ["..."]}

Need orders object with each order id as key. Provide statuses as strings.

Let's construct.
